passages.water_shutdown:
Date: August 10
Subject: Water Shutdown

Dear Tenant,

We regret to inform you that water service will be unavailable on August 15th from 9:00 A.M. to 2:00 P.M. We recommend that you store water in advance to cover your basic needs. This interruption is necessary in order to perform regular maintenance on the building’s water pipes. We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause.

Sincerely,
Building Management

questions.prompt: What is the main purpose of the email?

options.label: A
options.text: To schedule a tenant meeting about the building’s water pipes

options.label: B
options.text: To request that tenants make an effort to conserve water

options.label: C
options.text: To inform tenants about new water billing procedures for the building

options.label: D
options.text: To notify tenants about upcoming maintenance work

questions.answer: The management announces an August 15 water interruption for regular pipe maintenance. 正解：D。水の備蓄は付随する勧めで、会議・節水要請・請求手続きの変更は述べていません。

questions.prompt: Why must the service be interrupted?

options.label: A
options.text: To carry out routine upkeep on the plumbing system

options.label: B
options.text: To install new water meters in the units

options.label: C
options.text: To inspect a possible leak in the main water line

options.label: D
options.text: To upgrade the building’s water pressure equipment

questions.answer: The email explicitly says the interruption is necessary to perform regular maintenance on the building’s water pipes. 正解：A。routine upkeepは定期的な保守を意味し、メーター設置・漏水調査・設備更新ではありません。
